## Checklist

- [ ] Every new number has a provenance record (value, kind, state, reason, source, file, effective date, retrieved date).
- [ ] Nothing is invented. A blank or unparseable source value is left out and explained, never written as 0.
- [ ] `node build.js --check` and `node --test` pass.
- [ ] `npx playwright test` passes.
- [ ] UI changes: screenshots at 360px, light and dark, are attached below.
- [ ] New or changed sources are documented in `docs/DATA_SOURCES.md`.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased.
- [ ] A change to `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, a source or how a number is computed adds a numbered entry to `docs/DECISIONS.md`, and any entry it supersedes or amends gets a one-line note pointing at it.
